voiceEyesInitialize.summary: Initializes display-independent gaze/expression state before applying commands.
prerequisites: Import Voice Eye State and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use initialize voice eye state
examples.explanation: Block notation: Initializes display-independent gaze/expression state before applying commands. Command; no OLED initialization occurs.

notes: Display-independent semantic state for eight voice commands. Initialize state explicitly. Applying a command changes gaze OR expression; unknown, silence and empty commands preserve state. Optional rendering uses the separately initialized Robot Eyes library.
Source: bilingual-kws\esp32p4\microblocks\Voice_Eyes.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.

voiceEyesApply.summary: Applies a known semantic command to gaze or expression; unknown/silence/empty commands preserve state.
